title: English Around the World
text:
English is spoken in many countries around the world. Millions of people use it as a second language. It helps people from different countries talk to each other. Many businesses use English for their work.

Students often learn English at school. Some learn it online with videos and apps. English words are also found in many languages, including Turkish. People who travel also find English useful when they need help.
